name: @unitn-asa/deliveroo-js
description: Deliveroo.js Development Kit - Autonomous Software Agents - 2023
author: Marco Robol <marco.robol@unitn.it>

scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules packages/@unitn-asa/*/node_modules backend/docs backend/.git-revision backend/swagger.json frontend/dist
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../packages/@unitn-asa/deliveroo-js-sdk && npm test
scripts.dev-all: npm run dev & npm run dev-ui
